name: 92407 · Sn Bernrdno, CA
findings: ZIP 92407 (Sn Bernrdno) has 142 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92407 (Sn Bernrdno) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
